rule_or_requirement: Preserve qualified finishes while recovering from prolonged pixel-road visibility loss.
observable_information: Pixel-road center history, current inherited pixel action, private low-visibility count.
allowed_action_or_state_change: For the first 20 low-visibility decisions blend inherited steer halfway with +/-0.25 toward remembered pixel-road side, keeping gas/brake.
expected_success_endpoint: All six consumed control finishes retained, >=20 action changes, zero invalid actions and >=10-decision visibility-loss reduction on at least two of three slow-loss cells.
control: Exact frozen visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on six matched consumed TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Any lost finish, invalid action, fewer than 20 action changes or fewer than two shortened slow-loss intervals.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two arms on six consumed TRAIN cells, twelve episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU local diagnostic capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
